title: Encoder + Reranker enrollment and performance manifesting for catalog ingestion
creator: Asha Patel
description: Bring a new semantic encoder + cross-encoder reranker pair into the catalog as first-class artifacts. Produce a machine-readable performance manifest (performance-signature.json) that captures latency/throughput curves, accuracy on canonical eval sets (MRR/Recall@K), memory footprint, quantization compatibility, and recommended runtime knobs. This ticket covers ingestion hooks, deterministic admission checks, manifest generation, and a lightweight smoke canary flow for Dedicated/private deployments.
acceptance_criteria: A performance manifest is generated and attached to the model bundle in the catalog and visible in the Console model detail page
Manifest fields include: model_version, encoder_dim, quantization_profiles, latency_p50/p95 (1q, batched), throughput@batch_sizes, eval_mrr, eval_recall@10, memory_gpu_bytes, crc checksum
Deterministic admission gate runs (unit + integration) and fails the enrollment if top-level regressions exceed thresholds
Canary route (10% of traffic) can be enabled and will fallback to baseline variant on errors or SLO breach
End-to-end CI job that validates manifest schema and replays 1k synthetic queries against runtime is created
steps: Define performance-manifest schema and land JSON Schema document in infra/model-manifests
Add enrollment hooks to catalog-ingest service to call runtime-bench and collect telemetry
Run canonical eval suite (semantic-sim, multi-domain QA) and record MRR/Recall/precision metrics
Measure latency/throughput on target instance shapes (g4dn.12x, a100-40g) with and without 8-bit quantization
Wire the manifest into the Console; add a model detail card that surfaces recommended runtime knobs
comments: 2025-02-10 - Asha: Drafted scope and initial schema. Goal is to avoid manual PR'd profiles; manifests should be produced by CI and versioned with model bundle.

2025-02-12 - Luca: Bench harness added (PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/catalog/pull/412). Early runs show encoder dim=768, encoder latency p50=6ms (1q), reranker p50=22ms (1q). Will run quantized 8-bit next.
2025-02-14 - SRE (Priya): Note on memory: reranker peak GPU memory ~5.1GB on a100-40g with batch=8; need to add memory headroom recommendation to manifest.

2025-02-16 - QA: Integration gate discovered small accuracy drift when enabling 8-bit on the cross-encoder: MRR dropped from 0.792 to 0.772 on internal devset (delta -2.5%). We will add a quantization compatibility flag and require quality regression <2% for auto-acceptance.
2025-02-18 - Luca: Updated enrollment flow to emit 'quantization_allowed=false' if quantized MRR delta >2%. Manifest example attached in related_links.
Next steps: Add smoke canary to dedicated autoscaler and add dashboard panel for model manifest telemetry (latency/err rate per variant).
